turnAssumption.note: One authoritative simulation turn is one in-game calendar day. Production, transport ETAs and construction progress are driven by the central simulation clock.

HYDRAULIC_BRINE.name: Brine pumping / evaporation or direct extraction

HARD_ROCK_CRUSH_FLOTATION.name: Hard-rock drill, blast, crush and flotation

factoryCatalogPolicy.observedDataPolicy: Unknown real-world values remain NOT_RECORDED; factory profile values below are explicitly simulation-only.
factoryCatalogPolicy.quantityPolicy: Recipe coefficients operate on the explicitly declared simulation-resource quantity basis. Unit normalization is an explicit simulation-only bridge; it is not a real-world physical conversion.
factoryCatalogPolicy.missingInputPolicy: A production cycle requires every declared recipe input. Missing or untracked required inputs block the cycle.
factoryCatalogPolicy.outputPolicy: Output batches are created once per committed transaction, retain source-batch lineage and are added to the processed warehouse exactly once.
factoryCatalogPolicy.capacityPolicy: Factory profile capacity is a maximum processed production-unit quantity per simulation day; resource availability and all recipe coefficients further constrain output.

unitNormalization.factorPolicy: Unit bridges preserve numeric quantity only for gameplay. They must never be reported as real-world mass/volume equivalence.

inputSourcePolicy.internallyProduced: Every non-agricultural downstream recipe input has a producing processing rule or downstream recipe. Production still requires actual batches and stock; producer presence does not create material.
inputSourcePolicy.externalSectorInputs: Grain, vegetable oil, sugar, cotton fibre and wool fibre require an authoritative upstream batch from an agriculture/food/livestock runtime or a tracked import.
inputSourcePolicy.noFabricatedStock: External input descriptors are contracts only; they do not create inventory or quantity. Production remains blocked until recorded stock is delivered.
inputSourcePolicy.unknownInputs: An input without an industrial producer, source resource identity or explicitly declared external-sector contract is a catalog integrity error.

constructionMaterialPolicy.rule: Per-factory-type BOM derived from structural resources, the declared industry category, and each catalog processing rule's registered raw feedstock. Quantities scale with simulated construction cost. Values are gameplay-only units, not real-world engineering quantities.

employmentPolicy.rule: On commissioning, fill job slots from a known unemployed headcount. Reconcile by stable factory ID, and cap hires at the recorded unemployed pool.
employmentPolicy.jobScope: Direct jobs inside the factory asset, including operators, engineers, maintenance, logistics, quality, administration, safety, and support roles.
